correctness.rationale: The classical blow-up intersection product produces exactly 27 (-1)-line classes. Two meeting negative curves force a semidefinite 2x2 principal block, and a pairwise-skew set has intersection matrix -I; the support correspondence is bijective. The Frobenius-invariant support B is realized over the ground field by D=-K+2B with nef big positive part -K+B, verified against every irreducible curve. Exact finite reflection closure has 51840 elements and 25 conjugacy classes; all 2764 cliques and all 25 cycle profiles were exhaustively enumerated. An independently constructed orbit-union fixed-point algorithm checked all powers, and Burnside summed to 8*51840. The attached programs replay the computations.

value.rationale: The 2764 Zariski chambers are a natural invariant of big linear series on cubic surfaces. The complete 25-type arithmetic classification determines rational stable-base-locus support classes and their extension-field counts, and reveals that identical line splitting does not fix rational chamber counts (1 versus 13 with the same 3^9 line splitting). This is a meaningful natural complete classification, not an arbitrary slice or recomputation of the known total.
